description: A screen of drifting snow whose speed follows the voltage patched into it; the signal itself passes straight through to the output

inputs.text: The voltage that drives the snow: the flakes move at a rate of one plus five times its distance from 0V, so 2V or -2V sends them eleven times as fast as 0V does

outputs.text: A copy of the input, channel for channel

notes: the module has no knobs, switches or menu items of its own. Everything it does follows from the voltage at the Snow jack.
the snow keeps drifting at its base rate with nothing patched, so the screen never stops moving.
only the first channel of a polyphonic cable steers the snow, but every channel reaches the output.
